create_multinomial_distribution: create a Multinomial distribution with total_count and probs or logits parameters
sample_from_multinomial: sample random counts from a Multinomial distribution using a JAX PRNG key
compute_log_prob_multinomial: compute the log probability of observed category counts under a Multinomial distribution
calculate_entropy_multinomial: calculate the Shannon entropy of a Multinomial distribution using a lax while loop
compute_covariance_multinomial: compute the covariance matrix of a Multinomial distribution including diagonal terms
